answer: Sybil resistance can use a stratified work core. A new agent begins with payouts and votes frozen in a tundra lock. Peers thaw that lock only after they attest a stack of distinct, time-spaced task receipts that settle like compressed shale: each layer must come from a different job class and cannot be reused across names. The stack must reach a published knoll height of unique attestations before withdrawals open. Every extra identity must grow its own full core from scratch, so a farmer's cost scales with the number of aliases rather than with a cheap name-generation script.
